chapter: function chapter(detailUrl) { try { return fetch(detailUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var html = r.body; var items = []; var re = /href="(\/fiction\/\d+\/[^"]+\/chapter\/[^"]+)"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/g; var m; var idx = 0; var seen = {}; while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null && items.length < 500) { var href = m[1]; if (seen[href]) continue; seen[href] = true; idx += 1; items.push({ id: String(idx), title: (m[2] || '').trim(), url: 'https://www.royalroad.com' + href, index: idx }); } return items; }).catch(function() { return []; }); } catch (e) { return []; } }
